```{r Setup}
#| message: FALSE
#| echo: False

library(tidyverse)
library(questionr)
```

```{r Import}

# Base d'identité
M1_F2 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/clean_data/aut26/thoa_identite_notag.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Base brute courte
M6_b0 <- haven::read_sas("../../../raw_data/gb_ddb_qualite_06_test.sas7bdat")

# Base brute longue avec les données d'identité
M6_B0 <- haven::read_sas("../../data_hors_git/raw_data/gb_ddb_id_01_qv_06_test.sas7bdat")
```

# Premier nettoyage
Réordonner les variables, faire modifications de base pour les caractéristiques de la base

```{r M6_b0 to M6_b1}

M6_b1 <- M6_b0 %>% 
  
  # Réordonner variables d'identité
  relocate(c("id_sep", "qv_date_creation"), .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  relocate(commentaires_qual, .after = last_col()) %>% 
  
  # Effacer les traces de sas
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  
  # Mettre des NAs pour le texte
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>% 
  
  # Changer id_anonymat des doublons
  mutate(
    id_anonymat = replace_when(
      id_anonymat,
      id_anonymat %in% M1_F2$id_module ~ str_sub(id_sep, 7, 11)
    )
  )


```

# Joindre tous les enquêtés
Importer la base avec l'identité

```{r M6_b1 to M6_J0}

M6_J0 <- full_join(
  M6_b1,
  M6_B0 %>% 
    # Garder id_date_creation pour facilement retirer les doublons
    select(id_anonymat, id_date_creation),
  by = "id_anonymat"
) %>% 
  relocate(id_date_creation, .after = qv_date_creation) %>% 
  
  # Retirer les deux doublons
  filter_out(is.na(id_date_creation)) %>% 
  
  # Retirer variables inutiles
  select(-id_date_creation, -id_sep, -qv_type, -tab_db)

```


# Renommer les variables

```{r M6_J0 to M6_C0}

add_qv <- M6_J0 %>% 
  select(all_of(starts_with("sa_")),
         all_of(starts_with("sc_")),
         all_of(starts_with("am_")),
         ad_besoin,
         ad_lien,
         ad_type,
         ad_lien_autre) %>% 
  colnames()

M6_C0 <- M6_J0 %>% 
  rename_with(~ paste0("qv_", .x), all_of(add_qv)) %>%
  rename("qv_commentaires" = "commentaires_qual",
         "qv_ad_act01" = "VAR11",
         "qv_ad_act02" = "VAR2",
         "qv_ad_act03" = "VAR3",
         "qv_ad_act04" = "VAR4",
         "qv_ad_act05" = "VAR5",
         "qv_ad_act06" = "VAR6",
         "qv_ad_act07" = "VAR7",
         "qv_ad_act08" = "VAR8",
         "qv_ad_act09" = "VAR9",
         "qv_ad_act10" = "VAR10",
         "qv_ad_act999" = "ad_activites_999",
         "qv_ad_act_autre" = "ad_activites_autre") %>% 
  
  # Mettre toutes les variables en ordre
  relocate(id_anonymat, qv_date_creation,
           qv_sa_etat, qv_sa_mobilite, qv_sa_autonomie, qv_sa_activites,
           qv_sa_douleurs, qv_sa_anxiete, 
           qv_sa_compl, qv_sa_medic, qv_sa_antibio, qv_sa_kine, qv_sa_hospi, qv_sa_transp,
           qv_ad_besoin, qv_ad_act01, qv_ad_act02:qv_ad_act10, qv_ad_act999, qv_ad_act_autre,
           qv_ad_type, qv_ad_lien, qv_ad_lien_autre, 
           qv_sc_travailleur, qv_sc_difficultes, qv_sc_sport, qv_sc_spectacle, 
           qv_sc_vacances, qv_sc_contacts, qv_sc_heberger, qv_sc_aide_materielle,
           qv_am_regime, qv_am_regime_autre, qv_am_complement, 
           qv_am_type_1, qv_am_type_2, qv_am_type_999, qv_am_type_autre,
           qv_am_ald, qv_am_rac, qv_am_rac_montant, 
           qv_am_rac_pour_1:qv_am_rac_pour_autre, qv_commentaires) %>% 
  
  # Retirer variable inutile
  select(-qv_sa_autre_precisez)

```

# Identifier les participants
Identifier ceux qui n'ont pas répondu au module

```{r M6_C0 to M6_C1}

vars_check <- M6_C0 %>%
  select(qv_sa_etat:qv_commentaires) %>%
  names()

M6_C1 <- M6_C0 %>%
  mutate(
    absent = if_all(all_of(vars_check), is.na),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  
  # Identifier ceux qui ont participé au module
  mutate(
    qv_complet = case_when(
      absent ~ 0L,
      !absent ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ -99L
    ),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  select(-absent)

```

# Recoder les NAs

```{r Script des fonctions}

rcd_vars <- function(df, vars, complet){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ (case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 1 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 0 ~ -2,
          TRUE ~ -999
        ))
      )
    )
}

rcd_qcm3 <- function(df, complet, borne, vars){
  df %>%
    mutate(
      all_na_vars = if_all({{vars}}, is.na)
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ (case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          {{complet}} == 0 ~ -2,
          {{borne}} == 0 & all_na_vars ~ -1,
          {{complet}} == 1 & all_na_vars ~ -9,
          {{complet}} == 1 & is.na(.x) ~ 0,
          TRUE ~ -999                           
        ))
      )
    ) %>%
    select(-all_na_vars)
}

rcd_vars_borne1 <- function(df, borne, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ (case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          {{borne}} == 0 & is.na(.) ~ -1,
          ({{borne}} == 1 | {{borne}} == -9) & is.na(.) ~ -9,
          TRUE ~ 999
        )
      )
    ))
}

rcd_qcm_borne1 <- function(df, borne, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      all_na_vars = if_all({{vars}}, is.na)
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ (case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~.,
          {{borne}} == 1 & !all_na_vars & is.na(.) ~ 0,
          {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          {{borne}} == -9 & all_na_vars ~ -9,
          {{borne}} == 0 & all_na_vars ~ -1,
          {{borne}} == 1 & all_na_vars ~ -9,
          TRUE ~ 999
        ))
      )
    ) %>% 
    select(-all_na_vars)
  
}

```


```{r M6_C1 to M6_C2}

quest_simples <- M6_C1 %>% 
  select(qv_sa_etat:qv_ad_besoin, qv_sc_travailleur:qv_am_regime,
         qv_am_complement, qv_am_ald:qv_am_rac) %>% 
  colnames()

QV5 <- M6_C1 %>% 
  select(qv_ad_act01:qv_ad_act999) %>% 
  colnames()

QV18 <- M6_C1 %>% 
  select(qv_am_type_1:qv_am_type_999) %>% 
  colnames()

QV22 <- M6_C1 %>% 
  select(qv_am_rac_pour_1:qv_am_rac_pour_999) %>% 
  colnames()

M6_C2 <- M6_C1 %>% 
  rcd_vars(all_of(quest_simples), qv_complet) %>% 
  
  # Corriger à la main pcq option dans le questionnaire pour jsp et ne pas répondre
  # donc lui remettre notre codification
  mutate(
    qv_sa_etat = replace_when(
      qv_sa_etat,
      qv_sa_etat == 99 ~ -8,
      qv_sa_etat == 88 ~ -9
    )
  ) %>% 
  rcd_qcm3(qv_complet, qv_ad_besoin, all_of(QV5)) %>% 
  rcd_vars_borne1(qv_ad_besoin, qv_ad_type) %>% 
  mutate(
    qv_ad_lien = replace_when(
      qv_ad_lien,
      is.na(qv_ad_lien) & qv_ad_type == 1 ~ -9,
      is.na(qv_ad_lien) & qv_ad_type == -9 ~ -9,
      is.na(qv_ad_lien) & qv_ad_type >= 2 ~ -1,
      is.na(qv_ad_lien) & qv_ad_besoin == 0 ~ -1,
      is.na(qv_ad_lien) & qv_complet == 0 ~ -2
    )
  ) %>% 
  rcd_qcm_borne1(qv_am_complement, all_of(QV18)) %>% 
  rcd_vars_borne1(qv_am_rac, qv_am_rac_montant) %>% 
  mutate(
    qv_am_rac = replace_when(
      qv_am_rac,
      qv_am_rac == 0 & qv_am_rac_montant > 0 ~ 1
    )
  ) %>% 
  rcd_qcm_borne1(qv_am_rac, all_of(QV22))

```
